_comment: The Pi Durable Platform mark (inner SVG markup on the 64 grid), written by `npm run og` from ../pdp-assets/logo/<source>/: `svg` is mark-small.svg, the drawing for 20 to 47 px, used by components/logo.tsx (28 px, header and footer); `svgRegular` is mark.svg, the drawing for 48 px and up, used by scripts/og-image.mjs for the Open Graph card. `placeholder: true` means a neutral stand-in (an outlined square on the family's dark tile) drawn before the logo existed; `source` names the chosen logo folder once there is one. If the logo changes, run `npm run og` again and commit.
